task_instance: Run a read-only Procore connection smoke test for a given environment and company ID: authenticate with the OAuth Bearer token to verify identity, list visible projects with pagination, assert that a known permitted project appears while a known unpermitted project does not, and capture a secret-free receipt (status, normalized route, company/project IDs, page metadata, latency, hash).
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is proving a live connection to the Procore construction-management SaaS API. Every step (verify identity via the current-user/company endpoint, list projects, assert the permission boundary, capture latency/status) inherently requires sending authenticated HTTPS requests carrying a valid Procore OAuth 2.0 Bearer token with company-routing header to a real, account-bound Procore environment. The runtime grants no credentials and the safety rules forbid using credentials/tokens and account-bound services; there is no token, no permitted company/project, and no way to reach the service. A smoke test cannot be verified against stubbed/fabricated responses, and fabricating the API output is disallowed, so the actual deliverable (a real pass/fail connection proof) cannot exist here.
evidence: Read the SKILL.md at the skill path. The skill (procore-hello-world, v2.0.0) states compatibility 'Requires a valid Procore OAuth Bearer token and read access to at least one permitted company or project' and its five steps all depend on calling documented Procore API surfaces (current-user/company discovery, projects list with pagination) using a Bearer token and Procore-Company-Id routing. No token, account, or reachable Procore environment is available, and the added safety rules forbid credentials and account-bound live services; network fetch is also disallowed this round. Only input-sample creation is permitted, but a connection proof's deliverable is the real authenticated round-trip itself, which cannot be produced.
